source_consistency_flags: Abstract total n=68,723 vs Results n=67,823.
Narrow renal-composite definition in Methods vs broader definition in Abstract/Results.
Results prose renal HRs for ertugliflozin/sotagliflozin conflict with Abstract and Supplement Table 2.
DAPA-HF diabetes-status description conflicts between Results and Supplement Table 1.
Figure captions use 'credible intervals' despite frequentist methods/confidence-interval terminology.
schema_gaps: No dedicated systematic-review or network-meta-analysis result atom kind; normalized quantitative results use quantitative_result and methodological context/tags.
No dedicated source-consistency-conflict atom kind; reconciliation findings use atom_kind=other with assertion_origin=extractor_inference.
extraction_limitations: The review summarizes trial-level evidence; these atoms represent claims/results as reported by this secondary source, not re-extraction from each underlying trial.
Safety outcomes were not a substantive reported endpoint set in the supplied article despite clinically relevant agent selection questions.
P-score rankings are preserved as reported but should not be interpreted as direct head-to-head superiority.
